title: EMODnet Biology Occurrences (GeoParquet)
abstract: Darwin Core occurrence records of marine biodiversity from EMODnet Biology, packaged as GeoParquet 1.0.0, accessed via the EDITO STAC catalog.
description: EMODnet Biology marine biodiversity occurrence data distributed as GeoParquet 1.0.0. Each record is a Darwin Core occurrence with WoRMS Aphia identifiers, full taxon hierarchy (kingdom through species), sampling event metadata, depth ranges, and WGS84 point geometry. The full dataset (2026-05-13 release) contains 65.4 million rows. Accessed via the EDITO Digital Twin Ocean infrastructure on CloudFerro S3.
